sb.name: Adam
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Bloodied Fury
traits.desc: While Bloodied, Adam has Advantage on attack rolls.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Adam has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Adam makes two Slam attacks and uses Crush or Throw.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Lightning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 18) from one of two hands.

actions.name: Crush
actions.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 18, one creature Grappled by Adam. Failure: 13 (2d6 + 6) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Lightning damage, and the target has the Restrained condition. While Restrained, the target is suffocating.

actions.name: Throw
actions.desc: Adam throws a creature Grappled by him to a space he can see within 30 feet of himself that isn't in the air. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 18, the creature thrown and each creature in the destination space. Failure: 13 (2d6 + 6) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition. Success: Half damage only.

bonus_actions.name: Violent Leap
bonus_actions.desc: Adam spends 10 feet of movement to jump to a space within 40 feet that contains one or more Medium or smaller creatures. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 18, each creature in Adam's destination space. Failure: 14 (4d6) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition. Failure or Success: The target moves to the nearest unoccupied space.

sb.name: CEO Viktra Mordenheim
sb.languages: Common, Draconic, Dwarvish, Elvish, Goblin, Halfling

traits.name: Bolster Inventions
traits.desc: At the end of each of Viktra's turns, each of her Construct allies in a 5-foot Emanation originating from Viktra gains 5 Temporary Hit Points. This trait doesn't function if Viktra has the Incapacitated condition.

traits.name: Darklord Restoration
traits.desc: If Viktra dies, she revives with all her Hit Points in 1d10 weeks somewhere in Mordenheim Kinetics.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Domain)
traits.desc: If Viktra fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Viktra makes two Lightning Rod attacks. She can replace one attack with a use of Syringe.

actions.name: Lightning Rod
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 90 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) Lightning damage, and the target can't take Reactions until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Syringe
actions.desc:
Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature Viktra can see within 5 feet. Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition for 1 minute. While Poisoned in this way, the target suffers one of the following effects (Viktra's choice). The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. The target succeeds automatically after 1 minute:

- **Corrosive Serum.** The target takes 10 (4d4) Acid damage at the start of each of its turns, and its Speed decreases by 10 feet.
- **Deadly Serum.** The target takes 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns, and it can't regain Hit Points.
- **Mind-Altering Serum.** The target takes 10 (3d6) Psychic damage at the start of each of its turns, and it has Disadvantage on saving throws to maintain Concentration.

bonus_actions.name: Activate Constructs (1/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: Viktra casts [[Tools/Spells/Animate Objects|Animate Objects]], using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability.

legendary_actions.name: Shocking Prod
legendary_actions.desc: Viktra moves up to half her Speed and makes one Lightning Rod attack. Viktra can't take this action again until the start of her next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Static Explosion
legendary_actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 16, each creature in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point Viktra can see within 90 feet. Failure: 5 (2d4) Lightning damage. Success: Half damage.

sb.legendary_description: Legendary action uses: 3. One can be taken immediately after another creature's turn, and all uses come back at the start of this creature's turn.

sb.name: Created
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Berserk
traits.desc: Whenever the created starts its turn Bloodied, roll 1d6. On a 6, the created goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the created attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the created attacks an object. Once the created goes berserk, it remains so until it is destroyed or it is no longer Bloodied. The created's creator, if within 60 feet of the berserk created, can try to calm it by taking an action to make a DC 15 Charisma (Persuasion) check; the created must be able to hear its creator. If this check succeeds, the created ceases being berserk until the start of its next turn, at which point it resumes rolling for the Berserk trait again if it is still Bloodied.

traits.name: Lightning Absorption
traits.desc: Whenever the created is subjected to Lightning damage, it regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Lightning damage dealt.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The created has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The created makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) Lightning damage.

actions.name: Malfunction (Recharge 6)
actions.desc:
The created randomly creates one of the following effects (roll 1d4):

- **1: Insect Hive.** Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature within 10 feet. Failure: The creature takes 13 (3d8) Poison damage and has the Poisoned condition until the start of its next turn.
- **2: Melting Plastic.** Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 13 (3d8) Fire damage. Until the end of the target's next turn, the target's Speed is halved; the target can't take Reactions; and the target can take either an action or Bonus Action on its turn, not both. Success: Half damage only
- **3: Electrical Discharge.** Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature within 10 feet. Failure: 18 (4d8) Lightning damage. Success: Half damage
- **4: Haywire.** The created makes two Slam attacks and goes berserk. It rolls for the Berserk trait each round, whether or not it is Bloodied, for 1 minute.

sb.name: Echo
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The echo makes two Club attacks.

actions.name: Club
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.

bonus_actions.name: Automated Self-Preservation
bonus_actions.desc: The echo takes the Dash or Disengage action.

sb.name: Empty Echo
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Static Scream (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature of the echo's choice within 30 feet. Failure: 5 (2d4) Thunder damage, and the creature has the Deafened condition until the start of the echo's next turn.

bonus_actions.name: Automated Self-Preservation
bonus_actions.desc: The echo takes the Dash or Disengage action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Gerta makes three Cryogun attacks.

actions.name: Cryogun
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. Hit: 16 (3d8 + 3) Cold damage.

actions.name: Cryocannon (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. Failure: 36 (8d8) Cold damage. Success: Half damage.

bonus_actions.name: Camouflage Generator
bonus_actions.desc: While in Dim Light or Darkness, Gerta takes the Hide action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Hendrik makes two Slam attacks and uses Numbing Needle.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Numbing Needle
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14, one creature within 5 feet. Failure: 7 (2d6) Poison damage. Until the end of the target's next turn, the target's Speed is halved; the target can't take Reactions; and it can take either an action or a Bonus Action on its turn, not both. Success: Half damage only.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: Trigger: Hendrik is hit by a melee attack roll. Response: Hendrik adds 2 to his AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

sb.name: K-Nine
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The K-Nine has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the K-Nine's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

bonus_actions.name: X-Ray Scanning
bonus_actions.desc: The K-Nine gains Blindsight to a range of 60 feet. This Blindsight ignores Total Cover created by up to 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, or 3 feet of wood or dirt. Thicker substances or thin sheets of lead block the Blindsight as usual. This benefit lasts for 1 minute or until the K-Nine has the Blinded condition.

sb.name: Lamordian Evangelist
sb.gear: Quarterstaff, Shield (as metal placard; included in AC)

actions.name: Quarterstaff
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) Bludgeoning damage, or 5 (1d8 + 1) Bludgeoning damage if used with both hands.

actions.name: Feedback Loop
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 11, one creature within 60 feet. Failure: 4 (1d8) Thunder damage, and the target has the Deafened condition until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The evangelist casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Guidance|Guidance]]
- **2/Day:** [[Tools/Spells/Cure Wounds|Cure Wounds]]

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) Piercing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Disengage
bonus_actions.desc: The infiltrator takes the Disengage action.

sb.name: Lamordian Mercenary
sb.gear: Chain Mail (as bulletproof vest), Greatclub (as metal baseball bat), Pistol

actions.name: Greatclub
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Pistol
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +2, range 30/90 ft. Hit: 5 (1d10) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Static Arc
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 5 (1d10) Lightning damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The technician casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 11):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Minor Illusion|Minor Illusion]]
- **2/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Burning Hands|Burning Hands]], [[Tools/Spells/Grease|Grease]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Rudolph makes one Taser attack and uses Spellcasting to cast [[Tools/Spells/Command|Command]] or [[Tools/Spells/Mind Spike|Mind Spike]].

actions.name: Taser
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (4d6) Lightning damage, and the target has the Paralyzed condition until the start of Rudolph's next turn.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Rudolph casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Thoughts|Detect Thoughts]], [[Tools/Spells/Mind Spike|Mind Spike]]
- **1/Day:** [[Tools/Spells/Command|Command]]

bonus_actions.name: X-Ray Scanning
bonus_actions.desc: Rudolph gains Blindsight to a range of 60 feet. This Blindsight ignores Total Cover created by up to 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, or 3 feet of wood or dirt. Thicker substances or thin sheets of lead block the Blindsight as usual. This benefit lasts for 1 minute or until Rudolph has the Blinded condition.

reactions.name: Forcefield Generator
reactions.desc: Rudolph casts [[Tools/Spells/Shield|Shield]] in response to the spell's trigger, requiring no spell components and using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

sb.name: Shattered Echo
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.desc: The echo can mimic voices. A creature that hears the sound can tell it is an imitation only with a successful DC 10 Wisdom (Insight) check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The echo makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Unearthly Scream (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature of the echo's choice within 30 feet. Failure: 9 (2d8) Thunder damage, and the creature has the Deafened condition until the start of the echo's next turn. While Deafened, the creature also has the Frightened condition.

bonus_actions.name: Automated Self-Preservation
bonus_actions.desc: The echo takes the Dash or Disengage action.
